title: MD-B01 date-driven capability, provider limitation abstraction, and boundary-direction revalidation
objective: Advance MD-B01 coverage on predicate-bearing rules that can be proven against current code, without touching the requirement classification blocked by MD-DEP-0004.

new_test_file.covers: date-driven capability and provider limitation abstraction

work_performed.design_principle: Absence is only evidence when paired with a positive locator. Each isolation check is paired with an assertion that the vocabulary IS present in the adapter, so a rename or deleted file cannot turn the suite green by making the search find nothing anywhere.

negative_proof.method: Each mutation applied to a tracked file, guard executed, file restored via git checkout; restoration verified clean after every mutation.

negative_proof.process_note: N4 initially reported no reaction. Diagnosis showed the mutation script targeted a "use Illuminate" line the file does not contain, so the mutation was a no-op rather than the guard being blind. Re-run against the first "use App" line, the guard failed closed. A mutation that does not mutate is indistinguishable from a guard that does not guard unless the mutation itself is verified.

newly_satisfied_rules.rule: target date is the primary domain input, not derived from a provider default
domain capability must not be limited by a provider default query window such as range=10d
provider limitation must be isolated in the source adapter or import strategy
the domain must still support arbitrary date requests
a provider default window must not be treated as the platform official historical boundary
the platform accepts explicit requested dates as domain input
provider quirks must be absorbed by the acquisition strategy rather than inherited as domain limits
date-driven capability must never be reduced to provider default recent-window behaviour
market-data readiness must never depend on watchlist implementation, ranking stability, strategy metrics, profitability, or user preference
eligible may be preserved but never propagated to a new surface

rules_deliberately_not_claimed.rule: market-data facts may be inputs to watchlist policy, never outputs of it
rules_deliberately_not_claimed.reason: The import-direction guard proves no market-data class depends on a policy namespace, which is necessary but not sufficient. A policy component in another package could still write market-data tables directly, and this repository cannot prove the absence of code it does not contain. The guard was kept because it is valuable; the rule was not claimed because the evidence does not reach it.

rules_deliberately_not_claimed.rule: the decision horizon must never be expressed in calendar days
rules_deliberately_not_claimed.reason: Existing warm-up guards cover windows, not the horizon itself, and the 5-trading-day horizon has no code or config binding to assert against. A vacuously true check would be worse than none.

observations.subject: overloaded vocabulary confirmed in live code
observations.detail: PublicationGovernanceBindingService maps the IDX board code WATCHLIST to SPECIAL_MONITORING. This is an exchange market-structure fact, not policy leakage, and the normalisation is exactly the disambiguation Domain_Boundary_Invariants_LOCKED.md asks for. It is also a live example of why the policy-vocabulary guards target names on persisted surfaces rather than string literals in code.

observations.subject: provider identity versus provider limitation
observations.detail: Five application services reference the provider by name as a provenance label. That is permitted and distinct from transport shape. Conflating the two would have produced a false violation and a wrong finding.

test_suite_execution.failing_class_set: identical to MD-B01-A001; 39 classes, all owned by other stages under F-MD-B00-A001-001

residue_verdict.basis: Two test files added or extended, eleven matrix rows advanced. No runtime code changed, no schema changed, no strategy byte touched, no governance classification altered.

blocking_condition.statement: MD-B01 still cannot reach DONE. 18 of its 127 required rules carry no verifiable predicate, so 127/127 remains unreachable until a reviewed governance decision re-derives the classification.
blocking_condition.not_worked_around: No matrix row was reclassified at this attempt either.
